definition.title: Cutover: {{change}}
definition.body_md: A gated production change in the house style: Claude Code executes the steps that have an API or CLI, you keep the decisions and the GO gate. Fill in the values first; every command and link substitutes them.

steps_definition.title: Production cutover

intro.verdict_html: One production change, four phases, one GO gate. Nothing in Phase 0–2 touches live data; Phase 3 is the only irreversible step and it has a rollback.
prerequisites: The Supabase and Vercel CLIs logged in

phases.title: Decide and prepare
phases.lede_html: Everything here is reversible and can be done days ahead.

steps.title: Confirm the route
steps.body_html: Pick Staging rehearsal if the change touches auth or storage; otherwise Straight to cutover is fine for a schema-plus-code change with a rollback.

steps.title: Take the backup
steps.after_html: Compare row counts to live table by table; file size proves nothing.

verify_html: {{dump}} exists and the row counts match live
phases.why_html: The dump is the only restore point until nightly backups exist.

phases.title: Staging rehearsal

steps.title: Restore the dump into the local stack and replay the migrations

blocks.label: replay
blocks.text: supabase start && supabase db reset && supabase migration up

steps.title: Run the regression gate on the rehearsed data

blocks.label: gate
blocks.text: npm test && rm -rf .next && npx next build

verify_html: Tests green, build green, migration list shows every file

phases.title: Pre-flight

steps.title: Build gate on the exact tree being shipped

blocks.label: gate
blocks.text: git status --short && rm -rf .next && npx next build

verify_html: The dry run lists exactly the files you expect and nothing else

phases.title: Cutover
phases.lede_html: The GO gate is the only step that changes live state.

steps.title: GO
steps.body_html: Tick this only when 2.1 and 2.2 are green and the backup exists.

notes.html: After GO the migration runs against production. Rollback is the restore procedure below.

steps.title: Push migrations, then code

blocks.label: ship
blocks.text: echo Y | supabase db push && git push origin {{branch}}:main

steps.after_html: Watch the Vercel deploy reach Ready before smoke testing.

verify_html: The Vercel production deployment is Ready

phases.title: Verify live
verify_html: Everything the change touched works on the phone
phases.why_html: Automation sets Done with evidence; your live check is the separate verified signal.

steps_definition.rollback_html: Restore the public rows from {{dump}} into a fresh project, repair the migration history to the last good number, and re-point Vercel's env at it. Auth users are recreated by invite.

troubleshooting.symptom: db push stops on an operator error

troubleshooting.cause: a lint rule tsc does not enforce
troubleshooting.fix: run npx next build locally; never disable the rule
